note: The High unprotected `main` path was judged overstated: a writer pushing to main runs code on a runner with no secret, Low. The one secret, `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`, lives in `notify-slack`, which runs no pushed code and only on `failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule'`.

ceilings.pending: a job whose `if:` requires `failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule'` is still walked by the push entry, so the webhook secret of a job that never runs on a push is counted.
